tools.name: Burp Suite MCP (PortSwigger)
tools.blurb: Official Burp Suite MCP server — drive Burp from the agent for authorized web-app testing.
tools.setup: Install the MCP server extension from Burp's BApp Store, then enable it under Settings → MCP.

remote.name: burp
remote.tip: Enable the MCP server in Burp (Settings → MCP) and confirm the URL/port it shows.

tools.name: BurpMCP-Ultra

tools.setup: git clone https://github.com/Cy-S3c/BurpMCP-Ultra  # then follow its README to load into Burp

tools.name: BurpMcp

tools.name: Burp MCP Agents

tools.name: Pentest MCP
tools.blurb: MCP server wrapping common pentest utilities (nmap, dirb and friends).
tools.setup: git clone https://github.com/DMontgomery40/pentest-mcp  # see README for the run command

local.name: pentest
local.tip: Clone the repo and point the command at its server entry file.

tools.name: Metasploit MCP
tools.blurb: MCP bridge to the Metasploit Framework. Use only against hosts you're authorized to test.

local.name: metasploit
local.tip: Start msfrpcd first; set the RPC password/host the server expects. Authorized targets only.

tools.name: Shodan MCP
tools.blurb: Query Shodan (host/service intelligence) from the agent. Needs a Shodan API key.

local.name: shodan
local.tip: Add your SHODAN_API_KEY in the environment box after cloning.
